description: Taurus decan 3 (May 11 to May 20): personality, love, work and growth, with Saturn as sub-ruler of the third ten degrees of Taurus.
answer: In Western astrology, the third decan of Taurus covers 20° to 29° of the sign, roughly May 11 to May 20, with Saturn as its sub-ruler beside Venus. It is read as earthy patience turned into long-term ambition and lasting structures. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 3 personality
paragraphs: The last ten degrees of Taurus are Saturn's decan, the planet traditionally tied to Capricorn, and the influence is usually read as gravity in the best sense. Here the Bull is less content simply to enjoy solid things and more determined to build them. Third-decan Taureans are often described as serious, self-reliant and quietly ambitious, with a long view that sees ten years ahead as perfectly normal planning. They tend to respect tradition, earned authority and things that have stood the test of time. Trust is slow to form with them, but it lasts. Rushing them rarely works, and they tend to remember who tried.

Saturn adds discipline and endurance, which can make these natives formidable when they set a goal. They are rarely flashy, preferring to let results speak. A dry humour often surfaces once they feel safe. Yet Saturn can also bring a heavier mood: a sense of duty that postpones pleasure, or a worry that resources are never quite enough. Since Taurus remains a Venus sign underneath, the healthiest version of this decan weaves enjoyment into the structure rather than treating it as a reward for later. Built well, their lives often feel both sturdy and quietly beautiful. Patience is their long game.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 3 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the third-decan Bull is usually a slow, careful chooser who takes commitment seriously. They may seem reserved at first, revealing warmth gradually as trust grows. Reliability is their love language: turning up, keeping promises, planning for a shared future. They are often drawn to partners with maturity and staying power. The risk is becoming so focused on providing and planning that tenderness gets squeezed out. Deliberately scheduling time simply to enjoy each other, with no practical agenda, can keep these relationships warm as well as stable.

Professionally, this decan is a natural builder of institutions and long-term assets. Property, architecture, management, finance, agriculture, public service and heritage work often appeal. They are patient with slow progress and willing to master unglamorous fundamentals. Colleagues tend to see them as dependable and quietly authoritative. Their caution protects organisations from rash decisions, though it can also delay worthwhile risks. Pairing their steadiness with a more adventurous colleague often produces good results. Recognising when a structure has outlived its usefulness is an important professional skill for them.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Taurus decan 3: what Saturn adds
paragraphs: The third decan covers 20° to 29° of Taurus, which in most years means birthdays from May 11 to May 20. Its sub-ruler, Saturn, comes from Capricorn, the last earth sign after Taurus, so this decan borrows a little of Capricorn's character while staying Taurus at heart. The other two decans of Taurus belong to Venus (decan 1) and Mercury (decan 2). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Saturn contributes discipline, patience and a sense of responsibility. Under its sub-rulership a sign is said to take itself more seriously, plan for the long term, respect structure and earn confidence slowly through steady achievement. Saturnine decans are often linked with management, craft, institutions and long apprenticeships, and their usual lesson is to allow rest and lightness alongside duty. Set against Taurus's steadiness, sensual pleasure, patience and quiet determination, that Saturn note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Taurus decan 3
paragraphs: Growth for third-decan Taurus often means letting pleasure back into the plan. Try building rest and enjoyment into the calendar with the same seriousness as work. Notice when worry about scarcity is driving decisions that the facts do not support. Sharing responsibilities, rather than shouldering everything, can lighten Saturn's load and deepen trust with others. When a long-held approach stops working, treat adjusting it as maturity, not failure. Spending time in nature or with simple craft can reconnect this decan with the sensuous Venus side of the sign.

Within Taurus, decan 1 leans towards venusian steadiness, sensuality and loyalty at their most concentrated and decan 2 leans towards patient hands guided by a practical, curious, problem-solving mind. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the third decan of Taurus considered the most ambitious?
faq.answer: Saturn, linked with Capricorn, is the sub-ruler of these closing degrees. Astrologers read it as adding discipline, long-range planning and a drive to build lasting structures. Third-decan Taureans are therefore often described as the sign's most serious and goal-focused natives, though they may need reminders to enjoy life along the way.

faq.question: What are the dates of Taurus decan 3?
faq.answer: In most years May 11 to May 20, the days when the Sun is between 20° and 29° of Taurus. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Taurus decan 3?
faq.answer: Saturn. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Taurus's own ruler, Venus.
